title: The ALMA Survey of Gas Evolution of PROtoplanetary Disks (AGE-PRO). III. Dust and Gas Disk Properties in the Lupus Star-forming Region
question: What are the dust and gas disk masses, sizes and line-flux correlations of 10 Lupus disks around M3-K6 stars observed in the AGE-PRO Large Program?

data.bands: Band 6 (234 GHz, 1.28 mm) and Band 7 (285 GHz, 1.05 mm)
data.angular_resolution: ~0.35'' continuum Band 6, ~0.70'' Band 7; weak lines ~0.50'' (B6), ~0.80'' (B7) at robust 1.0
data.sensitivity: continuum ~0.1 mJy; 12CO ~7.0, 13CO and C18O ~4.0, N2H+ ~3.0 mJy km/s

what.value: Stellar Teff, L*, A_V and accretion rates (rescaled to Gaia DR3 distances)

evidence.quote: are from (cite: Manara_2023_PPVII), summarizing (cite: alcala_x-shooter_2014; alcala_x-shooter_2017; alcala_hst_2019; Herczeg_n_Hillenbrand_TTauri_SpT)

what.value: Thermochemical model grid of C18O line luminosities vs dust mass

evidence.quote: Figure [13](#fig:derive_Mgas_ruaud) shows the AGE-PRO $\mathrm{C^{18}O}\,(2-1)$ line luminosities ($L_\mathrm{C^{18}O\,(2-1)}$) with model predictions from (cite: ruaud_C18O_2022)

what.value: Inclination and position angles from visibility fitting

evidence.quote: we adopt the values from (cite: Vioque_AGEPRO_X_dust_disks) for consistency among the AGE-PRO papers.

what.value: Gas masses from DALI models for comparison

evidence.quote: The second set is from an accompanying AGE-PRO paper, (cite: Trapman_AGEPRO_V_gas_masses) (blue points)

recipe.method: Bayesian inference on HR-diagram with evolutionary tracks
key_parameters: uniform priors on model properties; Teff and L* uncertainties from Alcala et al.

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, flag line channels, average to 125 MHz, phase then amplitude self-cal, apply to line data, subtract continuum
tclean with Keplerian masks, robust 0.5 or 1.0, circularized versions for radii
key_parameters: velocity spacing 0.1 km/s for 12CO, 0.2 km/s other lines; CLEAN to 1 sigma

recipe.goal: Check detections with spectra and stacked profiles
recipe.method: Velocity-stacked spectra and radial profiles de-projected with disk geometry
Curve-of-growth on moment 0 maps with elliptical apertures; R68 and R90; cloud-contamination correction using uncontaminated half doubled for Lupus 2, 3, 6

recipe.goal: Derive dust masses and spectral indices
recipe.method: Optically thin M_dust = d^2 F / (B_nu(T) kappa); alpha_mm from 234 and 285 GHz
Kendall tau with censored data including uncertainties and upper limits

recipe.goal: Estimate gas disk masses from C18O luminosity
recipe.method: Linear scaling of Ruaud et al. 2022 track at same dust mass: Mgas = Mgas,model x L_obs/L_model; Rc=100 AU model for Lupus 1, 2, 10, Rc=30 AU for others
key_parameters: Uncertainties assigned manually as x3 and x1/3

evidence.quote: We find its flux density is off by a factor of 1.22 based on the analysis on Lupus 8

answer_key.quantity: Gas/dust radius ratio for Lupus 2 and 10

evidence.quote: their CO gas radii are about two times their dust radii (this is true for both $R_{68}$ and $R_{90}$)

answer_key.quantity: Kendall p, C18O vs 234 GHz continuum
Detection rate of 13CO / C18O vs earlier Band 6 survey

evidence.quote: AGE-PRO increases the detection rates of the rare isotopologue $\mathrm{{}^{13}CO}$ and $\mathrm{C^{18}O}$ from 10% to 100% and from 0% to 90%, respectively.

not_stated_but_needed: Exact self-calibration solint sequence and number of iterations per source
Image size and cell size for tclean
Spectral windows used and exact channel flags per execution
Flux calibrator names and flux scale uncertainty
Final per-source beam sizes for non-circularized images
Details of aperture selection for 13CO/C18O spectra
Uncertainty prior details for stellar mass/age grids beyond uniform priors
missing_for_reproduction: Image/cell sizes and exact tclean parameters
Ruaud et al. 2022 model grid values
score_reason: Data and scripts are public and the flux methods are clear, but many tclean and self-cal settings sit in the overview paper or scripts and the gas masses depend on an external model grid.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the flux measurement recipe is clear and results are numeric (fluxes, radii, dust masses).
